limitations: Per-country +/-epsilon independent coordinate control is a worst-case mathematical perturbation SET, NOT a fitted empirical joint distribution, UCDP first-complete-release revision or uncertainty interval. Historical 23.1..26.1 H2 country-max and within-fold P95 merely NOMINATE two stress magnitudes; neither predicts a future 27.1 revision rate nor guarantees a true 2027 alert selection. Top-k robustness is about RANKING membership only, not hit counts or prospective skill. Original risk groups are frozen by 2025 state, not redefined when later editions reclassify country-year origins. No 2027 outcome used.
perturbation_set: Every fixed 2025-state country transition score may independently vary by <=epsilon; clamp to [0,1], tie-break by numeric GWNO.
